correctness.rationale: Exact matrix entries yield a convergent shift-band decomposition for all Schatten strictly above one at strictly below one, while the nonzero periodic adjacent differences force divergent trace-norm lower bounds. The finite-row cycle identity gives the u_r/b_r decomposition. Summation by parts uniformly controls the zero-mean geometric remainder, Dirichlet controls periodic harmonic remainders, and a direct dilogarithm expansion yields the universal +A finite damping term. Digamma/trigamma partial fractions produce L(d). Weakly null block vectors show essential norm >= the square root of half the variance at t=1. A standalone checker passed 275 finite diagnostics, which are not used in lieu of proof.

value.rationale: The canonical bounded periodic multipliers capture the oscillatory complement to slowly decaying diagonal symbols and yield a complete trace/Schatten/compactness transition for a natural operator family. The sharp diverging energy coefficient twice the profile variance and the explicit finite correction the profile-specific correction reveal distinct universal and profile-specific behavior. Two regularizations have constants differing by a universal multiple one minus Euler’s constant, providing a precise comparison beyond known compactness and spectral results.
